# Independent AC-derived transaction metamorphic invariant: nested owner must leave

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    directory=Path(td)/'index'; store=iss.IndexStateStore(directory); conn=store._conn
    before=list(conn.execute('SELECT * FROM meta ORDER BY key'))
    conn.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
    with ic.writer_transaction(conn): conn.execute("INSERT INTO meta VALUES ('review_probe','sentinel')")

    conn.execute('ROLLBACK'); assert list(conn.execute('SELECT * FROM meta ORDER BY key'))==before
    try:
